pretreatments.description: Dilute citric acid pretreatment with operational conditions of 120-180°C, 20-90 min, and 3-12 wt% Citric Acid by weight, optimized for highest fermentable sugar release
Enzymatic hydrolysis using Cellic® CTec 3 HS cocktail at 45-50°C and pH 5.0-5.5, resulting in solid residual fraction (RSF) and liquid hydrolysates
